Existing methods to remove these antibodies (e.g., Protein A/G) were costly and time-intensive. This study developed a rapid PEG-8000-based method to deplete heterophilic immunoglobulins. The approach was validated in three independent cohorts to assess fucosylated kininogen as a biomarker. Prior work showed fucosylated kininogen combined with AFP achieves AUC >0.90 for HCC detection.
